How this list is made

  • Source: California ABC's daily data export (abc.ca.gov), file header "Updated Wednesday 11th of November 2026 02:50:22 AM". ABC's Conditions of Use: its information "is considered in the public domain".
  • Kept: applications (not issued licenses) with status PEND for fixed-premises on-sale license types: restaurants, bars, hotels, clubs, brewpubs and similar. One row per ABC file number.
  • Withheld: any owner name that doesn't read as a company. Those names are dropped before we store anything.
  • Excluded: names that suggest a hospital, clinic, nursing or senior-living facility, K-12 school, daycare or children's facility. The screen works on names, so it can miss a facility without a telling name, and it sometimes drops an ordinary restaurant whose name contains one of those words.
  • Applications, not openings. Some are new businesses, some are new owners or transfers, and some will be withdrawn or denied. ABC's license lookup usually shows which; for some applications in ABC's daily file it says "No license found", and a buyer's list includes those.
